parts.reason: Requires showing perpendicularity, which the mark scheme achieves via the dot product; dot product is an excluded concept ('scalar (dot) product, including the angle between vectors or lines'). Alternative methods (Pythagoras, equal diagonals) shown in mark scheme use only magnitudes/distances which are in spec (P10.4), giving full marks without dot product.

parts.label: d
parts.technique: Finding angle ADC using dot product / trigonometry with vector lengths
parts.reason: Mark scheme's primary and most alternative methods use the dot product formula between vectors to find the angle, which is explicitly excluded ('scalar (dot) product, including the angle between vectors or lines'). Trig alternative methods (Way 5/6) still require the dot-product-based rectangle proof context and are essentially finding angle between vectors via right-triangle trig derived from vector magnitudes, but the core skill (angle between vectors) is excluded regardless of the trig route.
